items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: Ralph told Woody about me... he said he’d write the book around me and all that. And I says okay, so I went with Woody.

ctx.x: Great. How did the first time with Woody Herman come about?

The first time with Woody Herman. I was with Russ Morgan before that. No I was with Red Norvo. And Ralph Burns was the piano player, and I went with Russ Morgan and Ralph went with Charlie Barnet and then he went with Woody, and Ralph told Woody about me. You know and I didn’t want to leave Russ Morgan. It was a nice job and all that. But he said he’d write the book around me and all that. And I says okay, so I went with Woody.
Were you “Flip” then? Did you get that nickname before?

items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And then Flip Phillips came in the band. I got him from Russ Wes Morgan's band in New York.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I would like very much for him to hear Flip Phillips' album.
